name: date-picker
description: An input trigger that opens a calendar popup for selecting a single date, date range, or typed date input.

dateFormat.rangePattern: MMM d, yyyy – MMM d, yyyy
dateFormat.rationale: Unambiguous across locales — avoids day/month order confusion (e.g. 06/07 reads differently in US vs UK). Always use this pattern for any date display in the system — never a numeric-only format.

invalid.notes: Uses [&[aria-invalid]] compound selector to beat data-[state=open]/focus-visible specificity. Blue ring must NOT appear when invalid.

composition.rangeOpen: Shows a two-month calendar popup, 520px wide.

accessibility.role: combobox on trigger; dialog or grid on popup
accessibility.screenReader: Announce selected date on close; announce Pick a date when empty.
accessibility.focus: Focus returns to trigger after date selection.
accessibility.touchTarget: Trigger is 36px tall; implementation needs 4px hit-area padding.

constraints: Always pair with a visible label.
Do not use Open as starting state.
Do not embed calendar directly without date-picker trigger.

useCases: A booking form needs a 'Check-in date' field that opens a calendar on click
A task management form requires a 'Due date' input alongside text fields
A report filter asks for a 'From / To' date range to scope the query
An HR form collects a date of birth in a standard form row
A scheduling tool needs a 'Publish at' field combining date and time
A content management form includes an 'Expires on' date field beside other metadata inputs

Default.whenToUse: Single date fields in any form context — button-style trigger

Range.whenToUse: Selecting a start and end date that define a period

Input.whenToUse: Form rows where the field must look like a text input alongside other inputs
examples: Date of birth in a profile form
Expiry date in a settings panel
Filter row in a dense table toolbar

comparedTo.situation: Date field inside a form that opens a picker on demand
Always-visible date display or selection embedded on a page

notes: Source markdown contains complete token, behavior, accessibility, and usage sections.

changelog.change: Documented date display format rule (tokens.dateFormat) — "MMM d, yyyy" pattern via date-fns, e.g. "Jun 18, 2026". Codifies existing implementation, not a behavior change.
Trigger icon moved from leading to trailing position.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.
